messages:
Priya (Billing): Customer 'CardioLabs' disputed INV-2026-0891 — says platform fee proration and midterm support tier change not billed. Attachment: customer_email.pdf
Ethan (Acct Exec): We approved the upgrade 2026-04-12 (deal note: CL-UPG-0412). Customer agreed to prorated charge.
BillingBot: invoice INV-2026-0891 generated by system; related_charge cr_bd22 status: created -> not_invoiced
Lina (Customer Success): Customer paid the posted invoice and needs a credit memo for AP reconciliation. They asked for the credit to show the day-count calc.
Priya (Billing): Quick calc request: support delta annual = $14,400, effective 2026-04-12 to renewal 2026-10-01 = 172 days -> prorate ~= 172/365 * 14,400 = $6,783. Any rounding rules?
Tobias (Legal): Contract amendment signed 2026-04-10. Clause: midterm changes bill prorata. No legal objections. Please reference amendment ID AMND-245 on the memo.
Marta (Revenue Controller): Policy: credits < $10k approved by Billing; >=$10k need Controller sign-off. This is under threshold. Please code GL 4302 and use reason 'midterm_support_prorate'.
Ethan (Acct Exec): Customer prefers a reissued invoice with negative line rather than a separate credit memo. Is that doable?
Priya (Billing): Our system issues credit memos for adjustments but we can export a PDF that mirrors a reissued invoice with a negative line for customer. We'll do that.
Lina (Customer Success): I'll confirm with the customer that PDF is acceptable.
BillingBot: billing_ticket BT-6689 created; awaiting_processing; approver=Priya
Priya (Billing): Action: I'll compute exact days with inclusive counting, draft credit memo referencing AMND-245 and INV-2026-0891, post it today and attach proof.
Marta (Revenue Controller): Noted. Please cc me on posting.
Ethan (Acct Exec): Thanks team, customer wants it before month-end close.
Priya (Billing): Will update thread when posted.
BillingBot: ticket_update BT-6689 status=awaiting_approval
